title: Ferrari Luce EV starts at $560,800 in the US, $80K less than expected
snippet: Ferrari’s first electric car, the Luce, will start at $560,800 in the US, with American deliveries planned for the second quarter of 2027. title: LiteLLM release pipeline hacked to distribute info-stealer malware
snippet: Hackers compromised the LiteLLM project's PyPI package and published malicious Docker images with a payload that steals credentials, secrets, and environment variables. [...]

title: Affirm CEO Levchin Sees Strong Demand Ahead of Sam’s Club Partnership
snippet: Max Levchin, founder and CEO of Affirm Holdings, says the company is seeing no slowdown in demand from consumers or retailers, despite concerns about squeezed household budgets and a challenging consumer-spending outlook. Discussing Affirm’s announced exclusive buy now, pay later deal with Sam’s Club, he says the partnership arrives ahead of the holiday season and reflects retailers’ interest in Affirm as a way for customers to pay. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: В симуляторе Ray‑Ban Display появилась возможность тестировать мобильные приложения без самих очков
